result.title: TANGO: Real-World Unregistered RGB-Guided Hyperspectral Super-Resolution with Two-Camera Acquisitions
result.comment: 18 pages, 11 Figures, 10 tables. Submitted to CVPR 2027
result.summary: Unregistered hyperspectral image super-resolution aims to recover a high-resolution HSI from a low-resolution hyperspectral observation and an unregistered high-resolution RGB reference. Although recent methods have begun to address the geometric misalignment between the two modalities, their evaluation is still constrained by the lack of a large-scale public benchmark based on real two-camera RGB--HSI acquisitions with a high-resolution HSI reference. To address this gap, we introduce DUET, the first large-scale public dataset for unregistered RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution, comprising 403 indoor and outdoor scenes captured with two separate RGB and hyperspectral cameras. We further propose TANGO (Two-camera AligNment with Gated Occlusions), which first compensates for the dominant cross-camera displacement through end-to-end global alignment and then refines the remaining inconsistencies with a coarse-to-fine local feature alignment. A learned gating mechanism further attenuates the RGB guidance where the two views cannot be consistently matched. Experimental results show that TANGO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both DUET and REAL across all evaluated scale factors, outperforming the strongest competitor on DUET by up to 2.29 dB in PSNR while requiring 2.5$\times$ fewer FLOPs. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/FagiolottoConSombrero/TANGO-DUET

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建了双相机采集的真实未配准 RGB–HSI 超分数据集 DUET，并提出 TANGO：先以端到端全局对齐补偿跨相机主位移，再用由粗到细的局部特征对齐修正残余不一致，并用学习到的门控在双视角无法一致匹配处削弱 RGB 引导。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其依据跨模态一致性学习门控、在不可靠处抑制引导信号的做法，可能可供核查为 VLM 潜在推理中视觉证据筛选与视觉信息注入权重的设计线索。
